description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class for handling 'UnrecognizedQueryParamException' in a REST API. It converts such exceptions into a structured JSON error response indicating invalid query parameters.

classes.name: UnrecognizedQueryParamExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class implementing ExceptionMapper to convert UnrecognizedQueryParamException instances into HTTP JSON responses for API clients.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an UnrecognizedQueryParamException into an HTTP Response with a JSON body detailing the validation error.
